course.summary: Certificate nearing expiry, or been off the ropes for a while? A short programme to sharpen you up before reassessment.
prerequisites: Hold an IRATA certificate that is current or recently expired (within 6 months)
A logbook available for review with the instructor
outcomes: Restore speed and precision across every manoeuvre at your level
Update your knowledge of the latest IRATA ICOP revisions
Identify and correct unsafe habits that have crept in

syllabus.title: Session 1 — Diagnostic
syllabus.detail: An instructor observes your full manoeuvre set and builds a personalised correction list.

syllabus.title: Session 2 — Targeted Correction
syllabus.detail: Intensive drilling on weak areas only — not a rerun of the entire syllabus.

syllabus.title: Session 3 — Mock Assessment
syllabus.detail: A dry run held to the standard and time pressure of a real IRATA Assessor.

course.certificate: A RAC statement of attendance. A new IRATA certificate is issued after a successful reassessment.

sections.body:
## Do not let your certificate lapse

An IRATA certificate is valid for three years. Once it has been expired for more than six months you must requalify from the level below — an avoidable loss of both time and money.

We send every RAC alumnus a free reminder 90 days before their certificate expires. Make sure we have your current WhatsApp number.

sections.title: Secure your seat on the next cohort
sections.text: Send your name, the number of participants, and the month you are aiming for. We confirm seat availability and paperwork the same working day.
